# module: dotenv-linter
# case:   override
# vars:
#   CARGO_BIN_UNIX_OVERRIDE=OVR-CARGO_BIN_UNIX
#   DOTENV_LINTER_LINT_SKIP_PATTERN_OVERRIDE=OVR-DOTENV_LINTER_LINT_SKIP_PATTERN
#   DOTENV_LINTER_VERSION_OVERRIDE=OVR-DOTENV_LINTER_VERSION
#   EXTRA_ARGS_OVERRIDE=OVR-EXTRA_ARGS
#   TARGETS_OVERRIDE=OVR-TARGETS

=== task: diff ===

      *) targets="$targets $argument" ;;
      -*) options="$options $argument" ;;
    case "$argument" in
    esac
    find "$target" -type f \( -name '.env' -o -name '.env.*' \) -print0
    printf '%s\000' "$target"
  "$bin" diff $options $targets
  done
  echo 'No matching dotenv files found'
  elif [ -f "$target" ]; then
  exit
  exit 0
  fi
  filter "SKIPFILES_PATTERN=$skip_pattern" |
  for argument in ; do
  if [ -d "$target" ]; then
  options=''
  set -- "$@" "$path"
  targets=''
  tr '\0' '
"$bin" diff $options "$@"
' >"$file_list"
done <"$file_list"
done | task --silent --taskfile "$REPO/taskfiles/dotenv-linter/../internal/skipfiles/Taskfile.yml" \
fi
fi
fi
file_list="$(mktemp)"
for target in $targets; do
if [ ! -s "$file_list" ]; then
if [ -n '' ]; then
if [ -z "$skip_pattern" ]; then
options='OVR-EXTRA_ARGS'
set --
skip_pattern='OVR-DOTENV_LINTER_LINT_SKIP_PATTERN'
targets='OVR-TARGETS'
task: "_diff:unix" finished
task: "_diff:unix" started
task: "_diff:windows" not for current platform - ignored
task: "_install:unix" started
task: "_install:windows" not for current platform - ignored
task: "cargo:_install:unix" started
task: "cargo:_install:windows" not for current platform - ignored
task: "cargo:install" finished
task: "cargo:install" started
task: "diff" finished
task: "diff" started
task: "install" finished
task: "install" started
task: Task "_install:unix" is up to date
task: Task "cargo:_install:unix" is up to date
task: [_diff:unix] bin="$(command -v dotenv-linter || echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin/dotenv-linter")"
task: status command [ "false" != "true" ] exited zero
task: status command [ -z "" ] || "$(command -v dotenv-linter || echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin/dotenv-linter")" --version | grep -Fq "" exited zero
task: status command command -v cargo >/dev/null 2>&1 && { [ -z "" ] || rustup show 2>/dev/null | grep -Fq ""; } exited zero
task: status command test -x "$(command -v dotenv-linter || echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin/dotenv-linter")" exited zero
trap 'rm -f "$file_list"' EXIT
while IFS= read -r path; do

=== task: fix ===

    OVR-EXTRA_ARGS 
    find "$target" -type f \( -name '.env' -o -name '.env.*' \) -print0
    printf '%s\000' "$target"
  "$bin" fix $targets \
  OVR-EXTRA_ARGS 
  elif [ -f "$target" ]; then
  exit
  fi
  filter "SKIPFILES_PATTERN=$skip_pattern" SKIPFILES_MATCHING=true |
  if [ -d "$target" ]; then
  set -- "$@" --exclude "$path"
  tr '\0' '
"$bin" fix "$@" $targets \
' >"$matched_files"
done <"$matched_files"
done | task --silent --taskfile "$REPO/taskfiles/dotenv-linter/../internal/skipfiles/Taskfile.yml" \
fi
for target in $targets; do
